comments.body:
Comes from new recipe that appears after you report Lighthouse of Alexandria (need to reach the deepest part of Sea of Wonders) from Ibn in Alexandria.

Recipe Name : Hyper Exploder (18)
Skill Reqs : Casting Rank 15
Ingredients : Exploder (10) + 5x Strange Cannon + 4x Set of Repair Tools

Stats :
85/85 Durability
Maximum PP points (according to JP wiki) 450
Range 510
Speed 7
Burst 7
Reload 2
